description: State Climate Projections 20km - Max Temperature bias corrected (DWER-144) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Water and Environmental Regulation. The Climate Science Initiative (CSI) State temperature projection 20km bias corrected dataset has been produced as part of the Climate Science Initiative program. This dataset contains maximum temperature projections. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Water and Environmental Regulation. Its tags are 20km resolution, CMIP6, Climate Risk, Climate Science Initiative, Climate projections. It offers 12 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, csv, fgdb, geojson, geopackage. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Active Acceptance). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
